basic_details.short_information: V. V. Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Fellow on a deputation basis for a period ordinarily not exceeding five years, with a pay scale of Level-11 Rs. 67,700-2,08,700. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Ph.D. in Social Sciences or relevant areas from a recognized University or equivalent. Eligible applicants can apply through the prescribed offline process by sending their complete Curriculum Vitae along with attested copies of supporting documents, certificates, and copies of publications by post to The Director General, V. Subscribe the cover with "Application for the post of Fellow on Deputation".
Forward the application by post to The Director General, V. V. Giri National Labour Institute, Sector - 24, P.O. Box No. 68, Noida - 201301 (U.P.).

rows.details: V. V. Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI)
Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
Deputation period ordinarily not exceeding five years
Pay Matrix Level-11 Rs. 67,700-2,08,700 as per 7th CPC plus allowances
Maximum 56 years as on the date of closing of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates from the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, autonomous or statutory organizations, PSUs, Universities, or Recognized Research Institutions must meet the following qualifications: Ph.D. in Social Sciences or relevant areas from a recognized University or equivalent. An eminent scholar with a good publication record. Officers of the Central Government, State Government, Union Territories, autonomous or statutory organizations, PSUs, University, or Recognized Research Institution fulfilling any of the following service conditions: Holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or With five years of service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in PB-3 Rs. 15,600-39,100 + GP Rs. 5,400/- or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or With six years of service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in the Pay Band-2 Rs. 9,300-34,800 and Grade Pay Rs. 4,800/- or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and Possessing qualification and experience in labour-related research, training, teaching, education project coordination, and management. Proven ability in different areas of pedagogic analysis. Proven capacity in creating labour information on/skills sets. Research papers in reputed journals and/or major national and/or international seminars. Proven record of organizing/coordinating research teams.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VVGNLI Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare a complete Curriculum Vitae. Attach attested copies of supporting documents, certificates, and copies of your publications. Subscribe the cover with "Application for the post of Fellow on Deputation". Forward the application by post to The Director General, V. V. Giri National Labour Institute, Sector - 24, P.O. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute will evolve the criteria for shortlisting candidates. The Curriculum Vitae duly supported by documents submitted by candidates will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection for the post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for VVGNLI Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for appointment by deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the date of closing of the receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include proven ability in pedagogic analysis, capacity in creating labour information/skill sets, research papers in reputed journals or national/international seminars, and a proven record of organizing or coordinating research teams.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose a complete Curriculum Vitae along with attested copies of supporting documents, certificates, and copies of their publications.
